chars.NOHAILA: NOHAILA: a 26-year-old Moroccan woman with long wavy dark-brown hair, wearing a mustard-yellow cropped blazer over a white top and wide light-blue jeans
chars.JACK: JACK: a 52-year-old American man with silver slicked-back hair and a short grey beard, wearing a camel wool overcoat over a black turtleneck and a gold wristwatch
chars.COWORKER: COWORKER: a young woman with short curly red hair wearing a lilac shop apron

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: NOHAILA stands behind the counter of a bright cosmetics boutique in an American city, smiling happily while reading a job offer on her phone, shelves of colorful makeup products behind her, calm background at the edges

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Small farewell party in the cosmetics boutique after closing time: COWORKER raises a paper cup in a toast while NOHAILA laughs, balloons and a small cake on the counter, warm evening light

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: JACK walks through the glass shop door into the farewell party, looking straight at NOHAILA with a confident smile, NOHAILA turns around surprised holding her cup

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Inside the cosmetics boutique, JACK leans toward NOHAILA asking questions with an insistent look, NOHAILA steps back slightly with an awkward polite smile, coworkers blurred in the background

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: JACK holds out his phone toward NOHAILA demanding her number, NOHAILA raises her hand politely refusing, shaking her head, tense moment in the boutique

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: NOHAILA, embarrassed and looking down, writes her email on a small paper card and hands it to JACK, who takes it with a satisfied grin

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: NOHAILA working relaxed and smiling at a modern office desk at her new job in an American city, laptop open, big window with city buildings behind her

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Evening at home: NOHAILA in comfortable clothes lying on a grey couch, a movie playing on the TV, she looks at her phone as a new notification lights up, cozy dim apartment

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Close-up of NOHAILA sitting up on the couch staring at her phone screen in shock, eyes wide, hand over her mouth, phone screen glowing on her face, dark room
